title: Affine criterion for schematic density of finitely many principal opens
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring [def-weil-affine-spectrum] and $f_1,\ldots,f_n\in A$, with $n\geq0$. Write $A_{f_i}=A[1/f_i]$ [def-weil-ring-localization-away] and $D(f_i)=\{\mathfrak p\in\operatorname{Spec}A:f_i\notin\mathfrak p\}$. Put $U=\bigcup_i D(f_i)\subseteq\operatorname{Spec}A$. The natural map $A\to\bigoplus_i A_{f_i}$ is injective if and only if $A\to A^{\oplus n}$, $a\mapsto(f_1a,\ldots,f_na)$, is injective. For the open immersion $j:U\hookrightarrow\operatorname{Spec}A$ [def-weil-open-immersion], these conditions are also equivalent to injectivity of the natural restriction map of sheaves $\mathcal O_{\operatorname{Spec}A}\to j_*\mathcal O_U$.
